info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Status-v1-spec
info.description: The Weather Alerts Status API provides real-time information on the current status of weather alerts. It serves a critical role in notifying users about active alerts, such as warnings or advisories, ensuring public safety and awareness in hazardous weather conditions. This API is typically utilized by developers building applications for emergency services, weather monitoring, and public information systems. By integrating this API, consumers can efficiently retrieve and display up-to-date weather alert statuses to their end-users.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of alerts.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of alerts in the system. It provides an overview of all active alerts and their respective states, enabling users to monitor alerts effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of alerts. It should conform to the defined schema, ensuring that all necessary parameters are included for a successful response.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current alert status.

ListWeatherAlertsStatusRequest.description: A string representation of the alert status request body.

ListWeatherAlertsStatusResponse_200.title: Alert Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the alert processing was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the alert.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the alert processing.

state.description: Current state of the alert processing.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the alert in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the alert status.

ListWeatherAlertsStatusResponse_200.description: Represents the response structure for the alert status operation, indicating the status of the alerts processing.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the alert.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the alert was created, in ISO 8601 format.

automated.description: Indicates whether the alert was generated automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the creation and processing of the alert.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request.
